conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, I tried using the ATM, but it says my card’s invalid. What’s wrong?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the trouble Sir. Can you share your account number to check the card status?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s six five, four three, two one, nine eight seven. I don’t know why it’s not working.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It seems your card was deactivated due to inactivity. I can issue a new one or reactivate it.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Reactivate it, please. I don’t understand why this happened.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It’s reactivated now Sir. You can use it immediately, and I’ll send a confirmation.
